title: xript Harness Steps
description: An ordered scenario executed against a harnessed host session. Each step is one action — load a mod, invoke an export, emit an event, fire a hook, execute code, resolve a slot or role, or read the journal. The same step vocabulary drives the CLI's batch mode and the MCP server's interactive session tools.

manifest.description: load-mod: the mod manifest — an inline object, or a path resolved relative to the steps file.

sourcePath.description: load-mod: entry script path, resolved relative to the steps file.

sourceTexts.description: load-mod: inline fill sources the mod references, keyed by the path the manifest names; each value is inline content.

sourcePaths.description: load-mod: fill-source paths the mod references, keyed by the path the manifest names; each value is a path resolved relative to the steps file.

source.description: load-mod: DEPRECATED alias for `sourcePath`. Read as a path relative to the steps file.

sources.description: load-mod: DEPRECATED alias for `sourcePaths`. Each value is read as a path relative to the steps file.

entry.description: load-mod: entry path key; defaults to the manifest's entry.script.

export.description: invoke: the export name to call.

event.description: emit: the host event id to broadcast.

hook.description: fire-hook: the hook or event-typed slot id to fire.

phase.description: fire-hook: the hook phase to fire.

data.description: fire-hook: the data passed to hook handlers.

code.description: execute: script source evaluated in the sandbox.

slot.description: resolve-slot: the slot id to resolve contributions for.

role.description: resolve-role: the provider role to resolve.

clear.description: journal: reset the journal after reading it.
